scripts.dev: concurrently -n admin,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/admin" "npm run dev -w apps/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/admin && npm run build -w apps/client
scripts.start: concurrently -n admin,client -c blue,green "npm run start -w apps/admin" "npm run start -w apps/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/admin && npm run typecheck -w apps/client
